response.justification: Bogdan is a solid, versatile full-stack/systems engineer with strong open-source and craftsmanship credentials, but he falls well short of the seniority, AI-specialization, and strategic-advisory profile required for this Director-level Principal Engineer AI Strategy role. His experience is ~14-15 years but skews toward web/product engineering rather than cloud/AI platform strategy, and there is minimal evidence of AI/ML expertise, published AI products, or executive-level customer/partner advisory work.
strengths: Broad, versatile engineering background across web, mobile, embedded, and infrastructure
Strong open-source track record and public speaking/teaching experience showing thought leadership
Recent exposure to AI-agent infrastructure (MCP, agentic tooling) at re:cinq
concerns: No advanced degree or formal AI/ML specialization; work history shows almost no ML/AI-specific projects beyond very recent tooling
No evidence of cloud platform strategy work, enterprise customer advisory, or influencing large-scale technical strategy
Career trajectory is IC-level product engineering, not Director-level strategic leadership or entrepreneurial scaling within large orgs

key_factors.factor: Lack of AI/ML specialization and credentials
No strategic/advisory or director-level leadership experience
Strong general engineering breadth and open-source leadership
